name: paper2poster-poster
title_zh: 论文进、海报出，连排版参数都替你定好
tagline_zh: 投会议前最怕做海报？给它 PDF 或 arXiv 链接，直接产出海报大纲、文案稿、版式简报和 YAML 草稿。
tagline_en: Dreading poster design before a conference? Feed it a PDF or arXiv link and get outline, copy deck, layout brief.
desc_en: Use when the user wants to turn an academic paper into a conference poster, poster outline, poster copy deck, poster layout brief, poster.yaml style draft, or Paper2Poster-ready generation package. Trigger for paper-to-poster requests involving PDF papers, arXiv links, manuscripts, PPTX posters, conference submissions, research summaries, or the Paper2Poster workflow.
why_zh: 不是泛泛总结，而是按 Paper2Poster 工作流逐层拆解：先定叙事主线，再落版式参数。
why_en: Not a vague summary—it follows the Paper2Poster pipeline: narrative first, then layout specs, output ready for the generator.
limit_zh: 只吃学术论文（PDF/arXiv/手稿），不吃博客、新闻或书籍章节。产物是设计稿和 YAML。
limit_en: Academic papers only (PDF/arXiv/manuscripts)—no blogs, news, or book chapters. Outputs are design specs + YAML, not final images; you still need the.
title_en: Paper in, poster out, layout params pre-decided
